_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform: `ruststep` 0.4 registered as the real ISO 10303-21 reader for stdio.ifc 2x3/🧱️base's exhaustive Ifc2x3Mutation vocabulary, the mutation catalog it is measured against, and the tolerant structural comparison profile a re-serialized IFC2X3 exchange structure needs against an independently parsed one. IFC2X3 is physically ISO 10303-21 (STEP physical file) syntax under a different EXPRESS schema -- ruststep parses it exactly as it parses the sibling `step/🔖️ap214/🧱️base` subset, which already established this exact §6 situation this wave.

oracles.rationale:
🩹️ RECLASSIFIED (ticket SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION, shard A10, 2026-09-02). This entry was registered `third-party-library` on the strength of a real crate that does genuine codec work, but the mutation's expected RESULT is computed by this owner's own `🦀️oracle.rs` -- its dispatch function's catch-all arm is `"mutation kind {...} has no oracle implementation"`, proof that every OTHER arm is an implementation, not a reading. Both halves of the comparison then descend from the same specification, so a shared misreading produces two agreeing wrong answers -- the one failure a differential oracle exists to catch. This is a `cross-semio-implementation`: a required SUPPLEMENT (metamorphic/inverse/round-trip evidence), never a substitute. A qualifying third-party reference for the mutation semantics is still owed. See $TICKET/📓️a10-oracle-honesty.md.

ruststep 0.4 is a real, actively-maintained ISO 10303-21/-11 (EXPRESS) parser for Rust, already linked and registered for the sibling `step/🔖️ap214/🧱️base` subset this wave -- confirmed here by reading its own source again (~/.cargo/registry/src/.../ruststep-0.4.0): `ast::Exchange`/`ast::DataSection`/`ast::Record`/`ast::Parameter`/`ast::EntityInstance` all implement `FromStr` over the real Part-21 clear-text grammar (multi-line records, nested lists, typed/complex instances, `$`/`*`/`.ENUM.`/`#ref` tokens), and IFC2X3 is physically identical ISO 10303-21 syntax to STEP AP214 under a different EXPRESS schema (`FILE_SCHEMA(('IFC2X3'))` in place of `FILE_SCHEMA(('AUTOMOTIVE_DESIGN'))`) -- verified against this subset's own real fixture (3464 real entities, a genuine forward-reference-closed subset of a real 21 MB IFC2X3 building model, parsed with zero errors). It has NO writer at all: `ast::ser::to_record` only builds a `Record` from an already-typed Rust struct, and grepping the whole crate source for `Display`/`fmt::Formatter` impls on `Exchange`/`DataSection`/`Record`/`Parameter` finds none -- there is no `to_string`/serialize path back to Part-21 text anywhere in the crate. Per the fleet brief's §6, this rules out `@mode-differential`: ruststep cannot be a second PRODUCER of mutated bytes to diff against. It is registered here strictly as the INDEPENDENT READER role instead -- every real mutation this subset's own oracle dispatcher (`../🦀️oracle.rs`) performs (via ruststep's real parse plus this module's own from-scratch Part-21 writer, since none exists to reuse and this subset's own production `step::engine::part21` writer must not be used as an oracle -- that would compare this repository's implementation against itself) is read back through a FRESH, independent `ruststep::ast::Exchange::from_str` call before being projected onto `semantic-ifc-v1`, and the identity round trip is checked the same way. This is real third-party evidence about the STRUCTURE of the result (entity graph shape, header schema, argument values as ruststep's own parser sees them), even though it cannot discharge a byte-level differential claim.

IfcOpenShell 0.8.4 is the reference open-source IFC implementation and, unlike `ruststep`, it both READS and WRITES ISO 10303-21: `ifcopenshell.open` runs its own C++ Part-21 parser against the real IFC2X3 EXPRESS schema and `ifcopenshell.file.to_string`/`write` re-serialize the whole exchange structure from the parsed model. That makes it a genuine second PRODUCER — the role `ruststep` cannot fill — and it is registered here for exactly the differential case `../../../../🧪️tests/differential-ifc-2x3` that claims it. It does NOT replace `ruststep-ifc-2x3-base-mutate`, which stays the schema-agnostic independent READER of `mutate-ifc-2x3`. Measured on this subset's own real fixture rather than assumed: IfcOpenShell is not a fixed point of this EDM StepFileFactory export (193 915 bytes in, 188 288 bytes out, projections identical instance for instance), which makes the round trip's byte tripwire real evidence here. One of the five kinds is NOT claimed: `ifcopenshell.file.remove` documents and performs reference repair, while `Ifc2x3Mutation::RemoveInstance` is a bare retain that deliberately leaves dangling references, and `#270549` — the instance the sibling case removes precisely because it is referenced — carries 8 inverse references in this fixture, so the two verbs would visibly differ. `remove-instance` therefore has no differential scenario and keeps its ruststep-backed scenarios next door.

comparisonProfiles.description: IFC2X3 (ISO 10303-21 physical file under the IFC2X3 EXPRESS schema) exchange structures compared by declared FILE_SCHEMA and the full id-keyed entity graph (every instance's type name(s) plus positional argument values, complex/multi-type instances kept whole, reals tolerant). Header timestamp, preprocessor/originating-system strings, comment placement and line-wrapping are writer freedom -- the same normative surface `Ifc2x3Diff`/`Ifc2x3Mutation` themselves operate over.
